whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Bakery Box,

I noticed your bakery has 117 reviews in Patrakar Nagar, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for birthday cake orders and menu inquiries.

Maine aapki bakery ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake booking, menu showcase, aur special occasion ordering integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://thebakerybox-demo.arclane.studio

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team The Bakery Box, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp cake ordering and mobile-first menu display for Patrakar Nagar customers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact bakery items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
